parameters.command:
cd /repo || { echo "RESULT=ERROR|/repo 마운트 안됨"; exit 0; }
git config --global --add safe.directory /repo >/dev/null 2>&1
git config --global credential.helper "store --file=/tmp/.gitcred" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'https://x-access-token:%s@github.com\n' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" > /tmp/.gitcred
chmod 600 /tmp/.gitcred
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "RESULT=NOCHANGE|변경사항 없음"; exit 0; fi
FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if ! git -c user.name="${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME:-n8n-bot}" -c user.email="${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL:-n8n-bot@local}" commit -m "chore: nightly sync $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') KST" >/tmp/c.log 2>&1; then echo "RESULT=ERROR|commit 실패: $(tail -1 /tmp/c.log)"; exit 0; fi
if git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_BRANCH:-main}" >/tmp/p.log 2>&1; then echo "RESULT=OK|${FILES}개 파일 커밋·푸시 완료 ($(git rev-parse --short HEAD))"; else echo "RESULT=ERROR|push 실패: $(tail -2 /tmp/p.log | tr '\n' ' ')"; fi
exit 0

parameters.text:
=:package: *GitHub 자동 푸시* ({{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') }})
{{ ($json.stdout || ('RESULT=ERROR|' + ($json.error || '알 수 없는 오류'))).replace('RESULT=OK|', ':white_check_mark: ').replace('RESULT=NOCHANGE|', ':information_source: ').replace('RESULT=ERROR|', ':x: ') }}
